newImplementation.basis: New implementation from the approved behavioral specification. No source, assets, fixtures, runtime data or history imported from the prior application.
newImplementation.dependencies: Pinned manifests and lockfiles identify third-party dependencies. Their distribution notices remain applicable.

excluded: Previous application source with unverified redistribution authority
Runtime state, environment files, credentials, screenshots and recordings
limitation: This records technical provenance and exclusions. It does not assert legal certification.

adaptedBaseline.basis: Changes to the declared upstream baseline implement the approved runtime, review and integration boundaries. Existing attribution and notices are retained.
